subject: Booking confirmed: {booking_ref} · {unit_name}
preheader: {arrival_date} – {departure_date}, {unit_name}. Your booking reference, payment and next steps.
heading: Thank you, {guest_first_name}, your stay is booked
body_html:
We have received your payment and confirm your booking of {unit_name} in {house_name}. Your booking reference is {booking_ref} – please quote it whenever you contact us.

{booking_summary}

{payment_table}

What happens next

  • Balance: if you paid the deposit, the date and method for the balance are shown in the payment overview. For card payments we charge the balance automatically to the same card and send you a reminder a few days before.
  • Getting here: three days before arrival we will email you directions to us. You can already open the location on the map: Getting here.
  • Check-in and check-out: check-in is {checkin_window}, check-out by {checkout_until}. Please bring an ID card or passport for every guest – we need them to register your stay.
  • Tourist tax is not included in the price and is payable on site.

You can view your booking at any time here:

{cta_button}

{account_invite}

Any questions? Call us on {business_phone} or simply reply to this email.

We look forward to welcoming you!
{business_name}
